task: Descale a coffee maker or kettle
steps: Fill the reservoir with a 1:1 water and white vinegar solution (or a descaling product).
Run a brew cycle halfway, then let it sit for 30 minutes.
Finish the cycle, then run 2 full cycles of plain water to rinse.
Wipe down the exterior and carafe.

materials.name: Lucy's Family Owned natural white vinegar 1 gallon
